description: This file contains language localization strings for the Summernote WYSIWYG editor in Finnish (fi-FI), including labels and tooltips for fonts, images, videos, links, tables, styles, lists, options, paragraphs, colors, shortcuts, help, history, and special characters.

methods.name: Immediately invoked function expression (IIFE)
methods.description: Defines a function that extends Summernote language options with Finnish translations.
